DroneOps Intelligence is a Web mission-operations platform for UAV operators and operations managers. It centralizes aircraft, operator, mission and restriction data; validates planned routes before approval; ingests MAVLink-derived telemetry; detects and manages incidents; and preserves post-flight evidence. Operators plan and monitor missions, while managers review proposals, restrictions and operational outcomes. Advisory AI summarizes authorized context and suggests risks and precautions without approving missions or controlling a UAV. The core value is a traceable workflow from planning through approval, monitoring and post-flight review, replacing fragmented maps, logs and spreadsheets. System structure and trust boundaries are shown in Report 4, SDD §1.1, Figures 1–2.

Automatic flight preparation and workflow ownership

Current ownership: MF1 / WF-01 — NghiaHQ (Ha Quang Nghia), planning and preflight; MF2 / WF-02 — ThongLQ (Le Quoc Thong), realtime monitoring, incidents and flight preparation; MF3 / WF-03 — DucDDA (Dang Dao Anh Duc), post-flight; MF4 / WF-04 — KhanhGNG (Giang Nguyen Gia Khanh), AI assessment. ThongLQ remains team leader and dossier coordinator.

AutomaticFlightRequested is optional and defaults to false. Changes follow the mission proposal and approval workflow. This release prepares readiness; dispatchEnabled is false. Neither confirmation nor gateway enrollment uploads a mission, arms motors, sends TAKEOFF/AUTO/MISSION_START, or changes the mission to InProgress.

For an approved, opted-in mission with a schedule, the backend opens confirmation at T minus 5 minutes and closes it at the scheduled start. The authenticated operator must keep a visible browser tab online. Presence is sent every 10 seconds and expires after 30 seconds. The selected, unrevoked mission connection must match the active UAV and flight-controller UID, with gateway heartbeat within 30 seconds and telemetry within 15 seconds.

Confirmation reruns preflight and binds readiness to the exact plan hash and connection ID. Readiness requires a passing preflight for that hash from the last minute. Changed plan/connection, stale presence or missing telemetry invalidates the conditions; the operator must review and confirm again. Dismissal, a hidden/offline tab or a missed window is not flight consent.

Autopilot execution remains a separate development phase: firmware/airframe capability detection, mission compilation and upload/read-back, command IDs/deadlines and replay protection, scheduled condition rechecks, local pre-arm/failsafe enforcement, and ACK plus observed flight-state verification. Validate ArduPilot/PX4 SITL, propeller-free bench operation and supervised flight before enabling dispatch. AI advice cannot authorize launch.

MissionAutomationService and MissionAutomationController provide GET /api/missions/automation/due and GET /api/missions/{id}/automation, POST presence/confirm/cancel and GET plan below that mission automation route. Owner authorization and uav_operator role apply. MissionAutomationState retains presence/confirmation, confirmed plan hash and connection ID; trusted enrollment and mission leases remain separate. FlightPreparationPrompt polls only when visible/online. Migration: 20261104115300_gateway_enrollment_and_flight_preparation.sql; deploy backend, frontend and gateway package together.
